definition.projection: dense Rademacher, 256 rows per group, groups (xyz; opacity; scale+rotation; SH), signs from per-(group, chunk) seeded CUDA generators (seed stream frozen globally, N1_SEED=20260928); group sketches L2-normalized then concatenated (1024-dim). No learned projection. Sketch of a view = projection of that view's true fused-loss gradient at the given state.
definition.stale: sketches from checkpoint C-5000 (SKETCH_SRC map; the 10000 source for 15000 anchors spans the last densification events — reported per checkpoint). fresh control = sketches at C itself.
definition.predictivity: predicted disagreement = 1 - cos(sketch_v1, sketch_partner) (concatenated unit-normalized); actual = 1 - global-normalized cosine of the current true gradients (Stage 7 ground truth). Primary: Spearman over all (anchor, partner) pairs per scene (7 pairs/anchor); also per overlap tier and per checkpoint; fresh-sketch control reported. scipy.stats.spearmanr.
